rom.description: A legally obtained Tomba! ROM, probably named `Tomba! (USA).bin`
rom._hash_note: No hash is claimed. The guide states none, and the worlds/tomba directory listing (read 2026-08-23) contains no rom.py.

emulator._source: The guide offers two and commits to neither: "RetroArch from: [RetroArch] 1.10.3 or newer" or "BizHawk from: [BizHawk] latest". Choosing between them would be our judgement, so the field stays null; the 1.10.3 floor belongs to the RetroArch route only.

client.name: Tomba! Client
client._source: Neither of SCHEMA's two rules answers this one. Rule 1: the world ships a standalone client -- worlds/tomba/client/client.py has `class TombaContext(CommonContext)` (read 2026-08-23), not BizHawkClient and not SNIClient, so it says nothing about which bridge could carry it. Rule 2: no RAM map Plugins/Scripts/games/tomba.lua exists. The guide's mention of BizHawk is about the emulator, and catalog/SCHEMA.md names "what another game on the same console does" as explicitly not a source.
client._protocol_source: worlds/tomba/client/emulators/bizhawk.py imports BizHawkContext, connect, read, write from worlds._bizhawk and defines class BizHawk(Emulator) with ID = options.Emulator.option_bizhawk. RetroArch is offered as an alternative in the same folder; BizHawk is the one we have a bridge for.
client._kind_source: worlds/tomba/components.py: components.append(Component(f"{constants.GAME} Client", func=run_client, game_name=constants.GAME, component_type=Type.CLIENT)) -- and worlds/tomba/client/ carries its own BizHawk and RetroArch drivers. The world owns the whole connector, so London must not load a Lua map or read memory; it starts the emulator and names the client.

apworld._source: setup guide: "Take the latest APWorld for Tomba! here: [T4g1/ArchipelagoTomba](that address)"

patch._source: Read 2026-08-23: the guide describes loading the ROM straight into the emulator and names no patch file; worlds/tomba has no rom.py; and TombaContext declares no patch_suffix. The world does ship worlds/tomba/client/patcher.py, i.e. its own client patches at run time -- but that is the world's business, not a patch step London runs.

_patch_extension_source: There is no Archipelago patch step to override: the worlds/tomba directory listing (read 2026-08-23) contains no rom.py, which is where catalog/SCHEMA.md locates an APPatchExtension. Only the directory listings, world.py, constants.py and client/client.py were read.
